added_residuals.title: Bind libc reading propositions to independently checked source contexts before typed discharge
added_residuals.why: Cycle1B migrates __errno_location and strerror nested_call_admission to3/5opaque atoms with stable formal proposition IDs, exact Context bindings, conditional Lean decomposition/counterexample theorems and direct/summary dependency controls. No typed registry entry, semantic consumer, verified library body or automatic verdict invalidation exists. DISCHARGE: independently establish each entire guarded proposition for its exact artifact/property/profile/scope/bounds/assumptions/source/build/evidence version and retained expected graph; preserve the accessor either-route alternative rather than requiring both. Any evidence recontextualization or checked verdict invalidation needs a separate scoped rule and matching proof; Unknown is not false and a refuted assumption is not a reachable C violation. Operator proposals AND/forbidden/OR/terminal remain separate semantics work.
